title: Shyness or Honour?
paragraphs: “I am returning after seeing the lover”, said the heroine.
“I understood that much-after seeing your dishevelled hair”, Was the quick reply of the confidante.
“What happened to cause such things disorderly in your form, dear? Tell me how your mind has its composure lost.”
For the confidante to see The heroine bared her shoulder.
Bloodshot marks! Signs of scratches like the crescent moon! Even when the bruises healed, the scars deep remained intact.

“My God! How bad! For heaven’s sake, don’t think I am insulting your hero; Does he belong to the species of animals or human beings? You got trapped by him; It would have been better even if he had gobbled you. But why did you permit him to maul you in frenzy of lust?”

“You are weighed down in anguish, confidante! My sweet kindly man he is. He maintained his distance with me, like an ascetic. Though we met each other daily there was no overstepping on his part. While displaying decorum during this secret love career One or two streaks of eccentricity did indeed sneak in; But we never let that to lead us to fleshly affair.”
“Then how come dear, your cheeks bear injury? Bruises on the hand? Swelling of fingers?”

Responded the heroine: “Both of us met in the rendezvous as usual, Which was soon followed by parting. Since parents’ approval had been obtained for marriage Thanks to the help of a trusted friend like you, With the happiness that Marriage would follow soon, I was crossing the sandy upland, and treaded the way without realizing That the shortcut filled with mullai flowers was also infested with problems.
A person with a grin approached me and said, ‘Have you finished the carnal affair one? Shall we get on with the next one?’

Since he sought to tarnish the very character of clandestine love career I had no desire to even look at that wretched man. Therefore, I added spring to steps and yearned to cross that garden Before he stretched his hands out to embrace me.
‘Don’t you worry about anything, Nobody would find out; Let go of shyness, woman,’ So saying he hemmed me in.
Wriggling away from his probing embrace, I said, ‘Shyness is superior to very life You, a lowly creature worse than a dog! Be it known to you!’ ‘Does shyness have such a high worth?
Young lady, don’t sport shyness; Give me your virginity for me to enjoy Giving up your bashfulness,’ he said.

‘You, the wolf of a man! Do understand one thing, Shyness is superior to life and chastity is superior to shyness. I declare right now, I am prepared to shed my shyness. Looking at shyness as a weakness in women You dare to defile me crossing me on the street, Don’t you?

Here, I shed shyness to save my chastity on my own. I swirled like a whirlwind and hurled a big stone at him. He also didn’t remain silent, And transformed himself into a sword to subjugate me. If I had donned the shyness, Pondering, ‘Should one assault a man?’ I would have lost my honour and chastity.
Now do you understand the reason for my injury, friend? Shyness is superior to life While honour is superior to shyness itself. That honour is woman’s chastity.” she concluded.
The confidante stood up glad at my deed And she took leave of me then.

> As the heroine goes herself > Seeking the hero she has fallen in love with, > Or as she says such words as are freed of wilfulness and guile, > Armed she is > With the saying of the ancients that > ‘Bashfulness is of greater worth than life itself, > And chastity unsullied stands superior to bashfulness too’ -- > And things lofty such as these > Constitute the thematic modes of Akam love proper. > > (Poruḷatikāram : Kaḷaviyal, verse 22)
